controlled_win.definition: JUDGED §14.2 metric. The controlled, symmetrized paired venue-side win rate: 0.5 x [P(venue side wins when the environment favours it) + P(opposite venue side wins when the environment is reversed)], computed per matched fixture. Weight 1 per matched pair; interval is 1.96 x SE of the paired series; pooling is the union of fixture keys.

controlled_cap.definition: The paired two-arm venue contribution is at or below the §17.4 combined cap of +2.5 points per 100 possessions.

paired_points_per100.definition: Venue-attributable points per 100 possessions: the paired two-arm margin gain over the possession base taken across the arms. **This is the figure §17.4 caps at +2.5.**

legacy_points_per100.definition: Venue-minus-visitor points per 100 possessions at the production environment, net of the neutral arm. §17.4 caps this at +2.5.

high_school.note: Reused controlled mirror triples. Points uncertainty fixes the observed denominator; source report has no independent per-arm box aggregates for the legacy efficiency-gap calculation. No new venue simulation or certification.
